title: Define DobeWorks Engineering Assurance Standard v1.0
objective: Define and validate DEAS v1.0 after preserving the exact Phase 1 and Phase 2 Generation 1 commits, prove Generation 1 fails the new semantic checks, define but do not execute Generation 2, and stop before remediation or merge.

scope.description: The exact 14-path C3 definition surface on deas/v1-phase2-generation-2, following the frozen C1 and C2 commits.

non_goals: Execute or create the Generation 2 correction
Adopt DEAS outside the DobeWorks repository
Begin Phase 3, assign a Role Disposition, qualify, or release
Access or change devices, storage, credentials, permissions, private sources, repository settings, collaborators, or unrelated files
Amend, rebase, reset, force-push, delete, or rewrite history
requirements: Define Core, Strict, and Exploratory profiles and Python, Document, Evidence, Validator, AI-Assisted, and Git overlays.
Define and enforce DEAS-PRE-001 through DEAS-PRE-010.
Provide static, semantic, validation, negative-test, exception, identity, rollback, and Git-first controls.
Require Generation 1 to fail exactly six frozen semantic findings.
Require Generation 2 conformance PASS to combine the exact manifest and Phase 2 public result with independent task, report, preservation, Role Disposition, DEGS, and DEAS checks.
Bound public text inputs and subprocess waits and outputs, reject unexpected diagnostics, parse structured results completely, and test timeout, exhaustion, and diagnostic paths.
Define the exact no-exception Generation 2 transformation without executing it.
Preserve the separate merge, release, Phase 3, Role Disposition, and cross-workspace authority boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: The public DEAS validator CLI tests pass.
Definition validation passes with three profiles, six overlays, ten invariants, matching Generation 1 findings, and a verified artifact manifest.
Direct Generation 1 conformance exits 1 with exactly the frozen six findings.
The task JSON validates and DEGS evaluates PASS.
Syntax, Strict function-size, JSON, links, diff, hash, and secret checks pass.
The C3 commit changes exactly 14 paths and the private draft PR remains unmerged.
No Generation 2 artifact or excluded action occurs.
assumptions: C2 and the immutable Generation 1 baseline are f45ae80c64a0aa8c723a5a58b4fbc7073682d349.
The exact 28 predecessor bytes remain represented by manifest 9ed515ac90cc100bae3d3a3baa674d6c2a200f5e18b3da4d7b4daaf979ac8d77.
alternatives: Use the C-specific Power of Ten rules literally
Rely on review without preventive invariants
Adopt the standard across workspaces before establishing one committed baseline
selected_design: A prospective profile-and-overlay standard with deterministic public-seam validation, immutable generations, explicit human-controlled exceptions, and Git-first evidence.

rollback.procedure: Preserve the exact branch, commits, remote, manifest, task evidence, and owned lock on failure. Do not amend, reset, rebase, force-push, delete, merge, or automatically roll back.

risk_analysis.summary: Tier 1 reversible private-repository documentation and validator work bounded by exact paths, frozen predecessors, deterministic checks, an early remote branch, and a draft pull request.

target_identity: C2 f45ae80c64a0aa8c723a5a58b4fbc7073682d349 plus the exact C3 paths and deas-v1-sha256.txt.
blast_radius: Exactly 14 C3 paths on one private task branch and draft pull request; no main, merge, release, device, storage, credential, or cross-workspace change.
stop_conditions: A predecessor, branch, path, byte, manifest, private-remote, task-lock, or writer check changes unexpectedly.
Any required check fails and cannot be corrected within the exact C3 authority, outside the expected Generation 1 nonconformance.
Any exception, unsupported fact, path expansion, authentication interaction, non-fast-forward push, or review finding requiring scope expansion becomes necessary.

Any Generation 2 mutation, merge, root adoption, Phase 3, release, Role Disposition, device, storage, credential, permission, physical, destructive, security-setting, collaborator, or unrelated action would occur.
